messages:
Rowan (partnerships): quick kick-off  SecretFlow (HSM vendor) + OrionSI (SI) requesting a joint marketplace tile + integration guide. goal: soft launch in ~11 days. scope: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta provisioning, KMS wrap/unwrap compat, attestation verification, small onboarding test harness.
Ken (security): checklist essentials: attestation chain + CRL checks, PKCS#11 + REST wrap/unwrap compatibility, signed key import flow, and KMS policy to require hsm:true tag for customer keys. i'll draft a short checklist.
Liam (SecretFlow): we support PKCS#11 and a REST key-wrap endpoint at /api/v1/keywrap. we have FIPS 140-3 certs and attestation bundles. will share test certs and sample responses.
Ava (OrionSI): we'll run a 2-customer pilot. need SCIM mapping and SSO metadata exchange steps. prefer SCIM v2 incremental sync using since param.
Mina (product): marketplace asks: short blurb, 3 feature bullets, 2 screenshots, and a data-flow diagram (no customer PII). can you upload an architecture PNG?
Liam (SecretFlow): uploading arch: https://files.secretflow.example.com/redwood/arch-compact.png
Ava (OrionSI): SCIM example snippet: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],"userName":"e.li@org.com","name":{"formatted":"Eli Li"},"emails":[{"value":"e.li@org.com"}],"groups":["infra"]}
Ken (security): rotation + fallback policy: HSM keys must support in-place rotation. if attestation or connectivity fails, Redwood should fall back to a Redwood-wrapped KMS key. also add SAML certificate/fingerprint exchange steps and a signed metadata endpoint.
Yusuf (legal): embargo: no public announcement before 2025-01-15 17:00 PT. need co-marketing addendum, logo release forms, and the approval flow (partner -> partnerships -> redwood legal -> partner signoff). i'll circulate templates.
Rowan (partnerships): action items: @Ken produce security checklist by Wed EOD; @Yusuf draft co-marketing addendum by Fri; @Ava produce pilot plan + SCIM sample; @Liam send cert bundles + test creds; @Mina create marketplace placeholder + marketing copy.
ops-bot: Repo created: partners/secretflow-orionsi - initial CI jobs: scim,saml,wrap-tests.
Liam (SecretFlow): sending cert bundle and test service account to the vault link now. will join test harness Mon.
Mina (product): we can gate the soft launch to pilot accounts. please provide partner slug and entitlements list.
Rowan (partnerships): thanks everyone  next sync Tue 10am PT. i'll post calendar and short agenda. :spiral_calendar_pad:
